limits: Five native userlands use one Docker/WSL kernel; not five independent kernels or physical hosts.

Final diagnostic-only deletion removes stale awaiting-DISABLE text from backend result. Native fault matrix binaries preceded that string deletion; all five real package/CLI gates and final Debian12 full build/CTest reran after it, with an explicit CLI-message regression assertion. Typed control flow is unchanged.
Existing authenticated loopback SSH connection survived on unmodified stock KillMode=process units; external networks and arbitrary launch topologies are not covered.
Harness prepares private directory mount boundaries, test keys/trust and udev readiness only inside disposable namespaces. No host SSH or security state changed.
No forced provider installation, service enable/start, legacy reload fallback, adoption or uncertain Prepared semantic recovery in production.
Schema2 ID-only wrapper release remains ID/structure-based and cannot detect valid body edit retaining ID; REFRESH of such wrappers is refused. No historical fingerprint synthesis.
Known released_awaiting_disable without error can be explicitly re-proven and acknowledged; unknown publication/runtime/journal/cleanup or failed reproof retains unresolved Prepared.
ALT RPM erase has no DEB purge counterpart. Actual DEB remove and purge executed on four profiles.
Research preview/module PASS is separate from actual package/CLI/IPC/session evidence.

Ubuntu admission fixture originally left ssh.service failed after deliberate syntax failure and started only socket; production correctly refused. Fixture now explicitly starts a valid service after the native start-limit interval when Result is failed. Final Ubuntu full suites rerun.
ALT global ru_RU numeric locale broke mountinfo parsing in actual daemon; fixed with classic locale, synthetic regression and real RPM gate.
Initial harness ACK health check observed journal after successful diagnostic reload; final check records health at operation return. Reload does not resolve Prepared.
